review.title: Add internal Accessibility selector engine
review.author: zhanghao1903
reviewed_scope: Current PR metadata, complete main-to-head diff, exact base and head SHAs, commit history, and exact-head GitHub CI
Focused 3392c27-to-d20636c three-commit remediation delta and b8d4bbd seven-file implementation
All WeChat action recovery paths: mapped navigation, node click, visible contacts, search focus, search result, Return, coordinate, selector, and strategy continuation
Native Accessibility action attempt reporting after the native API call
EOF, timeout, malformed response, native failure, pre-dispatch, and unsupported cross-package outcomes
Root and package suites, ten-iteration stress, compilation, release preflight, wheel checks, whitespace, docs, and clean-tree evidence
excluded_scope: Fresh real WeChat action or message submission
Post-submit delivery read-back and repeated live latency percentiles
Signed or notarized helper execution and real TestPyPI or PyPI publication
Private raw smoke artifacts and unrelated dirty worktree files
Ruff and mypy because they are unavailable and are not configured CI gates

decision.rationale: PRR-021 is resolved: one recovery predicate blocks every downstream mutation after dispatched, attempted, non-retryable, or unknown action outcomes. Real synthetic-worker counterexamples, path regressions, package/root gates, wheel checks, and exact-head CI pass.

summary: The remediation makes WeChat action recovery dispatch- and attempt-aware, treats an issued fallback as final, and corrects native actionAttempted reporting. No blocking finding remains for the reviewed snapshot; all deterministic PRR-021 checks and exact-head CI passed.

change_map.change: One predicate consumes attempt, dispatch, retryability, and unsupported evidence.
change_map.external_behavior: Unsafe or unknown action outcomes return without another mutation.
change_map.validation: Four real-worker unsafe outcomes and path-specific tests pass.

change_map.change: Proven pre-dispatch retryable and explicit unsupported outcomes retain one fallback.
change_map.external_behavior: Compatibility fallback remains available without replaying an action.
change_map.validation: Real worker lock-timeout and unsupported-response tests pass.

change_map.change: An issued selector fallback result is returned even when it fails.
change_map.external_behavior: A failed fallback cannot trigger coordinate or strategy replay.

change_map.change: Native AX errors set actionAttempted=true while pre-call failures retain false.
change_map.external_behavior: Downstream recovery can distinguish attempted native operations.
change_map.validation: Source assertion and structured-failure cross-package test pass.

change_map.change: No command, schema version, configuration key, dependency, or package version changed.
change_map.external_behavior: Recovery becomes fail-closed while public schemas remain stable.
change_map.validation: Package boundaries, docs, wheels, preflight, and CI pass.

findings.title: WeChat replayed actions after dispatched or unknown outcomes
findings.observation: The prior implementation selected fallback from generic failure kind and could ignore dispatch, attempt, and non-retryable evidence. The current implementation routes every affected recovery path through one fail-closed predicate and treats an issued fallback as final.
findings.trigger: A warm worker receives AXPress or AXSetFocus but its response is lost, malformed, times out, or reports a native API error after invocation.
findings.impact: Before remediation, one semantic request could perform two desktop mutations and use stale coordinates after an unknown first outcome. The current paths execute zero additional mutations in every unsafe case.

evidence.description: The central predicate gives positive attempt and dispatch evidence fail-closed precedence, requires explicit pre-dispatch plus retryable evidence, and preserves explicit unsupported fallback.
Mapped navigation, visible contacts, search focus, search result, coordinates, selector fallback, and strategy continuation all use the central decision or stop on the final fallback result.
The generated native action script sets actionAttempted=true after AXUIElementPerformAction or AXUIElementSetAttributeValue returns an error.
Real synthetic workers cover EOF, post-dispatch timeout, malformed JSON, native failure, pre-dispatch timeout, and unsupported action; path-specific tests cover every affected WeChat strategy.
The four unsafe cross-package modes passed ten consecutive iterations, covering 40 dispatch/outcome executions with no second mutation.
Exact-head CI passed unit tests, release preflight, all package tests, wheel and sdist builds, and distribution-content checks.

findings.remediation: Completed: preserve the no-replay boundary throughout WeChat, make a fallback result final, and report native action attempts accurately.
findings.verification: Completed: EOF, timeout, malformed response, native failure, pre-dispatch, unsupported, path-specific, package/root, wheel, preflight, and exact-head CI gates pass.

required_actions.action: Make every WeChat mutating fallback honor dispatch, attempt, and non-retryable evidence; correct native attempt reporting; add cross-package no-replay regressions.

assumptions: Explicit unsupported-operation results mean the requested native action was not performed unless positive attempt evidence contradicts them.
Once a mutating request is dispatched or attempted, missing response data leaves its desktop outcome unknown and prohibits another mutation.
Automatic fallback is safe only with proven zero dispatch plus retryability, or explicit unsupported action without a positive attempt.
